title: Glowing paper boat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='60%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a8e6ff' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a8e6ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='boatBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8f4ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b3d9f2'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='boatSide' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#cce8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7fb8e0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sail' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d4eaff'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='42' ry='28' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Water reflection glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#a8e6ff' opacity='0.35'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='20' ry='3' fill='#cceeff' opacity='0.25'/>

  <!-- Paper boat shadow/water line -->
  <path d='M18 72 Q50 80 82 72' stroke='#7fb8e0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Boat hull - left side -->
  <polygon points='20,68 50,76 50,64' fill='#9fd4f7'/>
  <!-- Boat hull - right side -->
  <polygon points='80,68 50,76 50,64' fill='url(#boatSide)'/>
  <!-- Hull bottom highlight -->
  <polygon points='20,68 50,76 80,68 50,72' fill='#cce8ff' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Paper fold line down center -->
  <line x1='50' y1='42' x2='50' y2='76' stroke='#8ec8ed' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Left sail (paper fold) -->
  <polygon points='50,64 50,32 26,60' fill='url(#sail)'/>
  <!-- Right sail -->
  <polygon points='50,64 50,36 72,58' fill='#c5e2fa'/>

  <!-- Sail fold detail -->
  <line x1='50' y1='34' x2='50' y2='63' stroke='#9fd4f7' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='32' y2='62' stroke='#b8dcf5' stroke-width='0.5' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Top tip glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='5' fill='#cceeff' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='44' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='48' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='58' r='0.8' fill='#cceeff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='54' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='28' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='30' r='0.7' fill='#cceeff' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Star sparkle cross shapes -->
  <g stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='0.6' opacity='0.7'>
    <line x1='30' y1='41.5' x2='30' y2='46.5'/>
    <line x1='27.5' y1='44' x2='32.5' y2='44'/>
    <line x1='76' y1='51.5' x2='76' y2='56.5'/>
    <line x1='73.5' y1='54' x2='78.5' y2='54'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Soft glowing light rays upward -->
  <path d='M50 28 L44 18' stroke='#cceeff' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.4'/>
  <path d='M50 28 L56 18' stroke='#cceeff' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.4'/>
  <path d='M50 28 L50 16' stroke='#cceeff' stroke-width='0.6' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
